geometry_principles.plan_shape: concentric circular standard floor plates; same centre through height; piecewise cylindrical stacks; no whole inner-cylinder twisting with A skin
geometry_principles.source: D10 p123 text and Fig3; B14_STRUCT p32
geometry_principles.enclosed_inner_facade: B wall follows standard circular slab perimeter; the glass reference offset to structural slab is unknown
geometry_principles.mechanical_amenity_floor: D10 Fig3b is triangular extended floor approaching A; cannot model every floor as the same circle
geometry_principles.rotation: Circle geometry has no visible plan rotation; module azimuth is unconfirmed and must remain an interface

measurement.source_view: orthographic structural elevation, not site photograph
measurement.perspective_correction: none; printed schematic assumed orthographic; no projective transform needed. Uniform scaling and source-version transfer are assumptions.
measurement.calibration: B14_STRUCT p32 bottom circular floorplate diameter82.2m / D10 Fig5 Zone1 measured width142px
measurement.calibration_version_conflict: 2014 published diameter applied to2010 schematic; 2014 book source plans are corrupt, so values are conditional and cannot be labelled final as-built.
measurement.uncertainty_formula: delta_R_pixel ~= 0.5*k*4px + R*(4/142); add schematic/version allowance; use±1.5m candidate radius bound, no statistical interpretation
measurement.height_scale: Not used; Fig5 lowest baseline is mat-top, not entrance0.000; tower632m cannot calibrate height directly from mat-top.

inner_top.basis: S13 Zone8/9 structural boundary mapped to end of ordinary B cylinders
inner_top.conflict: G01 p7 says Zone9 has no inner curtain or atrium, but G01 Fig2 observation starts580m and boutique boundary561m. Zone9 names in G01/S13 are not interchangeable. Final B termination somewhere in542–580m cannot be established from these sources.
inner_top.model_instruction: Build candidate B stacks through542m; retain top-of-B adjustable parameter and alternative upper control region; do not label542m confirmed finished B termination.

B_system.module_source: G01 p16; proposed uniform with slight zone variations, compared with1.5m tenant planning
B_system.module_status: 已证实早期建议；实际分格数待确认
B_system.B8: Bottom three floors of each atrium use insulating fire-resistant B8; system location supported by G01 Fig37 p17 and B14 fire chapter p86.
B_system.B1: Fourth atrium floor through top use B1 unitized system with tempered/laminated and fire-resistant glass; no final node dimensions in public source.
B_system.B8_height_instruction: Do not infer B8 exact13.5m from strengthening boundary. If a3×4.5m nominal display band is used, tag derived and actual atrium start offset unknown.
glass_config_versions: K16 later supplier8mm+12air+8mm, spatial assignment missing
B_system.solidify_instruction: Do not silently merge configs. Frame sections not dimensioned; use display section meta UNKNOWN and candidate assembly marked version.

floorplate.status: Published design endpoints confirmed; mapping each endpoint to Zone1/8 still derived.
floorplate.standard_plate: Circular floorplate; core opening footprint should follow actual core plan, not solid filled disc.
floorplate.slab_thickness_source: B14_STRUCT p38:typical office155mm composite total(80mm RC over75mm metal deck); MEP/Amenity200–250mm total(125–175mm RC over75mm deck); not150mm.
floorplate.floors: Only S13 anchors are direct nominal coordinates. Intermediate levels may be nominal4.5m candidate office bands; not a confirmed complete127/128 floor schedule.
floorplate.occupied_top: Owner O06 gives126th583.4m as accessible maximum; does not mean B wall exists through583.4m.
